# Final Mobile UX Plan

## Implementation order

1. Build prompt template module with four copy-ready H3 examples and direct Apply buttons.
2. Make template Apply update the existing textarea/draft in place so focus/readiness logic remains stable.
3. Build reference guide module with explicit frame/image/video/audio instructions.
4. Compact text-mode reference rendering; expand frame/reference modes only when media is relevant.
5. Replace fixed Generate dock with a normal-flow submission panel combining cost, readiness, Details, and Generate.
6. Add dedicated guidance styles and link them.
7. Extend browser smoke to assert submission panel and cost card do not intersect at 360px, templates populate prompt, and reference-mode guide text appears.
8. Run line/syntax/19-test/browser gates.
9. Release through an isolated worktree from current `origin/main`, fast-forward push, exact-SHA canonical deploy, and public 360px regression.

## Acceptance

- Zero overlap between Estimated Cost, Generate, or bottom nav at 360px.
- Prompt templates usable with one tap and Paste remains available.
- Reference instructions explain what media to upload and why.
- No console/network regressions.
- Original unrelated staged work remains untouched.
